items.source: Warning: this method does not release the provided Connection.
items.translation: 警告：此方法不会释放提供的 Connection。

items.source: ScriptException - if an error occurred while executing the SQL script
items.translation: ScriptException - 如果在执行 SQL 脚本时发生错误

items.source: connection - the R2DBC connection to use to execute the script; already configured and ready to use
items.translation: connection - 用于执行脚本的 R2DBC 连接；已配置并准备就绪

items.source:
Statement separators and comments will be removed before executing
individual statements within the supplied script.
items.translation: 在执行提供的脚本中的各个语句之前，将移除语句分隔符和注释。

items.source: resource - the resource (potentially associated with a specific encoding) to load the SQL script from
items.translation: resource - 要加载 SQL 脚本的资源（可能关联特定编码）

items.source: dataBufferFactory - the factory to create data buffers with
items.translation: dataBufferFactory - 用于创建数据缓冲区的工厂

items.source: This value may be supplied as the separator to executeSqlScript(Connection, EncodedResource, DataBufferFactory, boolean, boolean, String[], String, String, String) to denote that an SQL script contains a single statement (potentially spanning multiple lines) with no explicit statement separator. Note that such a script should not actually contain this value; it is merely a virtual statement separator.
items.translation: 该值可作为 separator 参数传递给 executeSqlScript(Connection, EncodedResource, DataBufferFactory, boolean, boolean, String[], String, String, String)，以表示 SQL 脚本包含一个语句（可能跨越多行），且没有显式的语句分隔符。请注意，此类脚本实际上不应包含该值；它仅是一个虚拟的语句分隔符。

items.source: Default end delimiter for block comments within SQL scripts: "*/".
items.translation: SQL 脚本中块注释的默认结束分隔符："*/"。

items.source: Default start delimiter for block comments within SQL scripts: "/*".
items.translation: SQL 脚本中块注释的默认起始分隔符："/*"。

items.source: Default prefixes for single-line comments within SQL scripts: ["--"].
items.translation: SQL 脚本中单行注释的默认前缀：["--"]。

items.source: Default statement separator within SQL scripts: ";".
items.translation: SQL 脚本中的默认语句分隔符：;。

items.source:
Execute the given SQL script using default settings for statement
separators, comment delimiters, and exception handling flags.
items.translation: 使用默认设置执行给定的 SQL 脚本，包括语句分隔符、注释分隔符和异常处理标志。

items.source: Execute the given SQL script.
items.translation: 执行给定的 SQL 脚本。

items.source: separator - the script statement separator; defaults to ";" if not specified and falls back to "\n" as a last resort; may be set to "^^^ END OF SCRIPT ^^^" to signal that the script contains a single statement without a separator
items.translation: separator - 脚本语句分隔符；若未指定则默认为 ";"，并作为最后手段回退到 "\n"；可设置为 "^^^ END OF SCRIPT ^^^" 以指示脚本包含一个不带分隔符的单一语句。

items.source: ignoreFailedDrops - whether to continue in the event of specifically an error on a DROP statement
items.translation: ignoreFailedDrops - 在遇到特定于 `DROP` 语句的错误时是否继续执行

items.source: blockCommentStartDelimiter - the start block comment delimiter
items.translation: blockCommentStartDelimiter - 块注释的起始分隔符

items.source: blockCommentEndDelimiter - the end block comment delimiter
items.translation: blockCommentEndDelimiter - 块注释结束分隔符

items.source: continueOnError - whether to continue without throwing an exception in the event of an error
items.translation: continueOnError - 在发生错误时是否继续执行而不抛出异常

items.source: Thomas Risberg, Sam Brannen, Juergen Hoeller, Keith Donald, Dave Syer, Chris Beams, Oliver Gierke, Chris Baldwin, Nicolas Debeissat, Phillip Webb, Mark Paluch
items.translation: Thomas Risberg, Sam Brannen, Juergen Hoeller, Keith Donald, Dave Syer, Chris Beams, Oliver Gierke, Chris Baldwin, Nicolas Debeissat, Phillip Webb, Mark Paluch

items.source: Used if neither a custom separator nor the DEFAULT_STATEMENT_SEPARATOR is present in a given script.
items.translation: 在给定脚本中既没有自定义分隔符也没有`DEFAULT_STATEMENT_SEPARATOR`时使用。

items.source: Mainly for internal use within the framework.
items.translation: 主要用于框架内部。

items.source: End of file (EOF) SQL statement separator: "^^^ END OF SCRIPT ^^^".
items.translation: 文件结束 (EOF) SQL 语句分隔符："^^^ END OF SCRIPT ^^^"。

items.source: Fallback statement separator within SQL scripts: "\n".
items.translation: SQL 脚本中的回退语句分隔符："\n"。

items.source: resource - the resource to load the SQL script from; encoded with the current platform's default encoding
items.translation: resource - 用于加载 SQL 脚本的资源；使用当前平台的默认编码进行编码。

items.source: commentPrefix - the prefix that identifies single-line comments in the SQL script (typically "--")
items.translation: commentPrefix - 用于标识 SQL 脚本中单行注释的前缀（通常为"--"）

items.source: commentPrefixes - the prefixes that identify single-line comments in the SQL script (typically "--")
items.translation: commentPrefixes - 用于标识 SQL 脚本中单行注释的前缀（通常为"--"）

items.source: Field Details
items.translation: 字段详情
